items.title: Rotate the literal signed Gaussian kernel average

source.anchor: AppendixB2 standing range; AppendixB2.2 p4.1 fixed-Q conjugation covariance and full-Haar change of variable underlying Ex58. Only the literal Gaussian-formula average is covered.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. ASTIS isolates the explicit-formula fixed-Q invariance step; Gaussian-law identification and the norm-axis conclusion are separate.

items.statement: Let n>=3 and kappa>=4. For O in the full real orthogonal group, let A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T) be the existing literal precision, and define the explicit real formula p_O(x)=sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A_O x/2) on real coordinate n-space, with n/2 a real exponent. For every vector x, O -> det(O)p_O(x) is absolutely integrable under the actual canonical normalized full-O(n) Haar probability. For every fixed Q in full O(n), including reflections, E[det(O)p_O(Qx)]=E[det(O)p_O(x)]. This statement concerns the displayed formula itself and does not identify it with the density of an actual Gaussian probability law.
assumptions: The AppendixB2 standing bounds n>=3 and kappa>=4 are retained, although the explicit algebraic invariance proof needs less. No L1, continuity or covariance hypothesis is added.
The law is the same actual canonical normalized Borel Haar probability on the full real O(n); both determinant components are allowed.
Vectors are real coordinates on Fin n, dotProduct is the Euclidean quadratic form and Q acts by matrix multiplication. The formula uses real exponent (n:R)/2 and the nonnegative real square root.
The local formula p is literal. This theorem defines no Gaussian probability measure and assumes no density identification, normalization or covariance fact. Those remain separate obligations.

obligations.label: Finite signed full-Haar formula average invariant under every fixed orthogonal action

bindings.boundary: Only fixed-Q invariance of the signed Haar average of the literal Gaussian formula. Identifying that formula with the actual N(0,A_O^-1) density, probability normalization/covariance, orthogonal transitivity and the full x -> ||x||e1 statement Ex58, joint spatial/Haar integrability and Fubini, original H(lambda) identification, sphere/Poisson evaluation, TV/amplification/transcript/eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open. The source uses the Gaussian density notation; the present scoped statement makes the formula explicit and retains the missing law-identification edge.

assumption_deltas.source: AppendixB2 standing n>=3,kappa>=4; full Haar O(n), every Q and x. p4.1 uses the Gaussian density p_O and its conjugation covariance.
assumption_deltas.lean: Same standing range and full Haar; the real formula p_O is explicit. Fixed-x Haar L1 and covariance/measure preservation are internal outputs. Identification with a Gaussian probability density remains a separate excluded source obligation.
assumption_deltas.reason: The binding is scoped solely to the fixed-Q calculation on the literal formula. No Gaussian law is chosen, no extra premise is added, and no claim of full Ex58/norm-axis/Fubini completion is made.
